title: Drone frame to orthophoto geolocalization with LightGlue
summary: Matches a nadir drone frame against a georeferenced satellite or orthophoto tile with SuperPoint + LightGlue, fits a MAGSAC homography with OpenCV, and maps the frame centre through the GeoTIFF geotransform to lat/lon. The geometry (affine geotransform, homography mapping, WGS84 UTM, haversine) is a stdlib module with unit tests; the pipeline points at UAV-VisLoc, VPAIR and University-1652 for imagery and at hloc / AnyLoc for retrieval over large maps.
verified: geo_math.py and test_geo_math.py ran with python3.14.7 stdlib on 2026-11-06 (12 tests OK), output shown in README; geolocalize.py is an unverified sketch: syntax-checked only, requires torch, lightglue, opencv-python, rasterio and numpy.
